title: LOOK: PH eyes stronger trade, agricultural ties with Thailand
summary: President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. met with Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and discussed a wider economic cooperation and possibly establishing stronger trade and agricultural ties.

blocks.text: President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. met with Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on the sidelines of the 49th ASEAN Summit. Photo from Presidential Communications Office (PCO)
President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. met with Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and discussed a wider economic cooperation and possibly establishing stronger trade and agricultural ties.
In the sidelines of the 49th ASEAN Summit, Marcos told Anutin that Filipino businesses and agricultural producers stand to benefit from stronger trade and agricultural ties with Thailand.
The two leaders were also open to explore ways to expand bilateral trade and strengthen food security, regional developments, and shared commitment to peace and stability. — BAP, GMA News
